definitions.explanation: The process of something abstract, theoretical, or imagined becoming real or concrete. Often used for plans, fears, predictions, or ideas that come to fruition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現実化|げんじつか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: To work toward making one's dream a reality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現実化|げんじつか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It will still take time for the plan to become reality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{現実化|げんじつか}してきた。
examples.english: The effects of global warming have been becoming reality.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧ (reality) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation into). A common noun-forming pattern where ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ turns a noun into "becoming X" or "making into X."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現実化|げんじつか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become reality, to materialize
- {現実化|げんじつか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work toward realization
- ⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{現実化|げんじつか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a risk materializes
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{現実化|げんじつか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a concern becomes reality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧: realization, achievement — more common in everyday use; focuses on achieving a goal
- ⟦{具体化|ぐたいか}→具体化：20775_gutaika⟧: making concrete — focuses on turning abstract ideas into specific plans
- ⟦{顕在化|けんざいか}→顕在化：09041_kenzaika⟧: becoming apparent — focuses on hidden things becoming visible
